text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Morocco's athletes score handsomely in Athens athletic World Championships.
- Employees will vote from 26 to 30 September for their electoral colleges, later to select representatives to the Chamber of Counsellors (upper house) of the parliament.
- Britain granted 6,400 entry visas to Moroccans in 1996.
- More than 500,000 expatriate Moroccans returned home since June through Spain's port of Algeciras.
- More Moroccan beaches are threatened by pollution.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri pays a get-well visit to Ali Yata, opposition Socialism and Progress Party leader who was hurt in a car accident last Saturday.
- Ali Yata's health condition still worrying.
